			gr[ vert[i][j][1] ].pb( vert[i][j][0] );
		}

		while( !q.empty() ){
			x = q.front(); q.pop();
			y = x%100; x/= 100;
			
			REP( dd, 4 ){
				nx = x+ds[dd][0];
				ny = y+ds[dd][1];
				if( nx >= 0 && nx < dim && ny >= 0 && ny < dim && labsci[nx][ny] != 'Y' && reach[nx][ny] > reach[x][y]+1 ){
					if( labcap[nx][ny] <= '9' && labcap[nx][ny] >= '1' ){
						if( reach[x][y]+1 <= die[nx][ny] ){
							cap[ vert[i][j][0] ][ vert[nx][ny][1] ] = INF;

			}
		}	
	}
